svg.text: Final Fantasy X (PAL SCES_504.90) — Decompilation Code Map
Byte-accurate memory map of Main ELF .text (2.0 MB), subsystem progress, 584 EE battle-effect overlays, and IOP/VU1 inventory
1. Main ELF .text Memory Map (0x00100000 – 0x0030049C, 64 KB per row)
Every colored block is drawn at its exact byte address and length. Hover any block in a browser to see function name, address, and size.
Sorted by total code size. Percentage shown is decompilable C coverage (excl. policy-asm).
Each tile = 1 container. 492/584 (84.2%) are 100% C (333 full + 159 policy-only); 0 untouched.
4. Whole-Game Inventoried Code Scope (Unique Code Bytes, Deduplicated)
Proportional view of all known executable code across EE, deduplicated battle-effect overlays, IOP IRX modules, and VU1 microcode.
